tokensForDev is included in totalTokensToSwap and ETH split
swapTokensAtAmount caps contractBalance processed in swapBack

devWallet is the destination of the low-level ETH call

_transfer invokes swapBack when the canSwap conditions hold
_transfer invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when LP burn window elapsed
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth for the swap portion
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain
swapBack performs an ETH low-level call to the dev wallet before finishing
swapBack performs a final low-level ETH call to the marketing wallet using the full balance
swapTokensForEth delegates to the router swap
addLiquidity delegates to the router addLiquidityETH
auto burn transfers pair tokens to the dead address
manual burn transfers pair tokens to the dead address

_transfer moves the remaining amount to the recipient
swapBack path approves the router to spend contract tokens

The low-level ETH call to marketingWallet can re-enter swapBack before token accounting settles on the caller side
The low-level ETH call to devWallet can re-enter swapBack through the receiver
The router swap transfers SOAR tokens and can trigger token transfer logic while swapBack is still executing
addLiquidityETH executes external WETH/pair logic that interacts with the SOAR token
pair.sync() reads SOAR balances from the external pair and can invoke token balance queries

normalization_plan.reason: 'from' is only meaningful as the source address argument of _transfer
'to' is only meaningful as the destination address argument of _transfer
'amount' is only meaningful as the transfer amount argument of _transfer
'fees' is a transient local holding the amount moved by the fee transfer operation
'contractTokenBalance' is a transient local used only for the canSwap gate in _transfer
'tokenAmount' is only meaningful as the argument of swapTokensForEth
'tokenAmount' is only meaningful as the token argument of addLiquidity
'ethAmount' is only meaningful as the ETH value argument of addLiquidity
'contractBalance' is a transient local of the swapBack distribution math
'liquidityTokens' is the token amount forwarded into the addLiquidity operation
'amountToSwapForETH' is the token amount forwarded into swapTokensForEth
'ethForMarketing' is a transient share consumed by the swapBack distribution logic
'ethForDev' is exactly the value forwarded to the dev wallet low-level call
'ethForLiquidity' is the ETH value forwarded into the addLiquidity operation
'percent' is only meaningful as the burn ratio argument of the manual burn
'newAmount' is the validated value written by updateSwapTokensAtAmount
'newNum' is the validated value written by updateMaxTxnAmount
'newNum' is the validated value written by updateMaxWalletAmount
'updAds' is the mapping key written by excludeFromMaxTransaction
'isEx' is the mapping value written by excludeFromMaxTransaction
'account' is the mapping key written by excludeFromFees
'excluded' is the mapping value written by excludeFromFees
'pair' is only meaningful as the validated pair argument of the setter
'value' is only meaningful as the flag forwarded to the internal setter
'newMarketingWallet' is the value assigned to marketingWallet
'newWallet' is the value assigned to devWallet
'_frequencyInSeconds' is a validated argument stored by setAutoLPBurnSettings
'_percent' is a validated argument stored by setAutoLPBurnSettings
'_Enabled' is the argument stored into lpBurnEnabled
'_marketingFee' is an argument of the buy fee update
'_liquidityFee' is an argument of the buy fee update
'_devFee' is an argument of the buy fee update
'_marketingFee' is an argument of the sell fee update
'_liquidityFee' is an argument of the sell fee update
'_devFee' is an argument of the sell fee update
